> We need to ensure there is information about adding newly created pages to the configuration for the doc generator

Sure. Right now MkDocs only complains about files, not mentioned in navigation tree, but it could be configured to fail in such cases (`build --strict`)

> Can something be done about the colour so the logo works better?

I used existing logo. Maybe, it worth to create monochrome variant or so.

> > We need to ensure there is information about adding newly created pages to the configuration for the doc generator
> 
> Sure. Right now MkDocs only complains about files, not mentioned in navigation tree, but it could be configured to fail in such cases (`build --strict`)

Yes, at least we want the build to fail if someone adds a new `.md` file under `docs/` which is not on the docs page.

> 
> > Can something be done about the colour so the logo works better?
> 
> I used existing logo. Maybe, it worth to create monochrome variant or so.

The logo is good, but the orange/red is not ideal.

> Yes, at least we want the build to fail if someone adds a new .md file under docs/ which is not on the docs page.

Then I need to move `/docs/examples`  somewhere… to `/examples`, say. Is it OK?

> but the orange/red is not ideal

I choose closest one to `hsl(340, 83%, 84%)`. Propose any color scheme which you prefer, I have (almost) no preference — just to avoid bikeshedding. Such kind of tweaks could be done in subsequent PRs, of course.
@kradalby Done. Right now I used default scheme.
